<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

RULING 2026-09-02 (government rulings/2026-09-02-claude-inbound-accept-is-global.md, Jordan: 'the global accept fix is fine, get it in, get it working, make sure it gets set on other machines too'). Evidence: with `"crossSessionInbound":"accept"` in ~/.claude/settings.json a RUNNING Claude session (vicuna, up since Aug 28) went from held/refused to delivered/injected-to-transport (spine 2077) — Claude re-reads settings live, no restart. Without it the Claude client holds or refuses every pij frame (client-side gate; pij's own sender gate is already open after s121/af139cb4). Today it was hand-applied on one machine; this plan makes pij apply it itself, idempotently, everywhere. The from-mode=bypass wire marker stays withheld (uds.rs:925 pin stands).

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- G1 ensure_claude_inbound_accept(): for each Claude home (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR if set, else $HOME/.claude; plus $HOME/.claude-alt when it exists) read settings.json; if the key is absent or not `accept`, write a timestamped backup then rewrite with ONLY that key added/changed (preserve every other key and ordering as far as serde_json allows); malformed JSON → refuse to touch it and report; missing file → create it with just that key.
- G2 Call sites: rs daemon boot (run_daemon in crates/cli/src/main.rs, before listening) and every Claude registration (adopt / spawn / phonehome path through crates/daemon/src/registration.rs register()). Idempotent, cheap (one stat + read when already accept).
- G3 Visibility: one startup log line naming homes touched/skipped; a spine event `config.claude-inbound-ensured` with {home, before, after} on every CHANGE (not on no-op); `pij-rs doctor claude-inbound` prints the current state per home without writing.
- G4 Never emit from-mode on the wire; this plan changes no transport frame.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No change to crates/transport/src/uds.rs frames or the uds.rs:925 pin.
- No omp/pi changes.
- No legacy TS daemon changes.
